items.title: Apple's Siri AI Can Be Swapped Out for Claude, ChatGPT, Code Shows
items.author: tosh https://news.ycombinator.com/user?id=tosh
items.summary: Code sleuth "pdfu" has uncovered iOS 27 and macOS Golden Gate private frameworks that show Apple has designed its new Siri architecture to work with third-party AI models at what appears to be a surprisingly deep level. One mechanism called Model Delegation allows Claude to appear as a Siri extension in the same way as the existing built-in ChatGPT extension.
